title: Samuel C NDE 6284
content: I awoke at about 2 AM, having a powerful thirst. I decided to get up to get some water from the kitchen. On the way, I experienced severe pains in my shoulders, back and arms. I got to the sink and drew the water, but then fell to the floor. At this time I felt myself walking through this ‘tunnel’ which seemed to me to be more like an arboretum with light shining through here and there. At the end of this tunnel there seemed to be a brightly lit grassy area. I reached this area, turned and began to walk toward a very bright light. At this point I heard a beautiful feminine voice say ‘you can’t go on; they say you have more to do’. Now at this time I wanted very much to go on, I was disappointed at this news. Next, I found myself still hearing this voice but back in my kitchen somewhere near the ceiling looking down at my body lying on the floor. I felt the most powerful love both for this person on the floor and for whatever entity was in the room with me, the intensity of which was indescribable. There is no doubt in my mind God was there; again the voice saying ‘you have more to do’. I felt myself agreeing now with this and descended down from the ceiling towards the back of my ear. I then awoke in severe pain again and crawled back to the bedroom on my hands and knees. I woke up my wife, who then called the paramedics. They arrived and did some tests, the data from which went to a hospital electronically. The hospital communicated the necessity for immediate transfer to the hospital for heart attack treatment. My wife asked the doctor if she should call our son (who was in New York at the time) to come to California. He said, 'Absolutely, Yes.' He didn't think I would make it. However, I wasn't too concerned because I had been told by a higher authority that I would.
